title: Render the read-only Dataset Governance projection

gates.name: dataset_presentation_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/dataset-governance.spec.ts

verify: Independent browser/request verification compares every rendered Dataset field with the protected response, covers pagination/retained history, and proves zero review/transition/evidence/curator/trainability mutation request or UI-derived inference.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-010 RED: no PWA Dataset consumer exists; GREEN: exact protected response values render read-only and no UI/network path sets or infers status/evidence/split/confirmation/curator_decision/can_train_on; decisive comparison: response-to-DOM equality, request log, controls/route scan, and unchanged authority state; artifact: Dataset UI evidence under .tasks/TASK-091-T2-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Show the minimum traceable Dataset authority fields in the first demo while keeping every lifecycle and trainability decision in Dataset Governance.
success_outcome: The PWA renders exact authorized Dataset Candidate values and pagination with no mutation control, request, local inference, or authority promotion from other UI/evidence surfaces.
anti_goals: Do not add Dataset review/edit/transition/split/evidence/curator/trainability controls or client-side derived can_train_on.
Do not infer Dataset state from photo, manifest, Timeline, Feed, or browser state.

stop_conditions: The view requires a Dataset mutation or field outside the registered read response.
The PWA cannot display the values without inferring lifecycle/trainability from a non-authoritative surface.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Dataset Governance remains the provider and sole mutable authority.
Render exact server values and canonical pagination without adding state-changing controls.
invariants: UI Feed, photo, manifests, Timeline, raw agent output, and UI state never grant trainability.
can_train_on is copied from the protected response and never recomputed.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-010: response-to-DOM parity, authorized pagination, retained history, zero Dataset mutation request/control, and no authority inference.
Dataset presentation spec locator remains one read-only result; provider task proof stays with TASK-090.
